guide.safety_reason: Using a washing machine with detergent as shown is a routine household task.

steps.instruction: Pull open the soap drawer on the washer.
steps.title: Open Soap Drawer

steps.instruction: Pour soap from the green bottle into the drawer.
steps.title: Add Green Soap

steps.instruction: Push the soap drawer closed on the washer.
steps.title: Close Soap Drawer

steps.instruction: Open drawer and pour blue liquid into the drawer.
steps.title: Add Blue Liquid

steps.instruction: Push the soap drawer closed on the washer.
steps.title: Close Drawer Again

steps.instruction: Turn the round dial on the washer to choose cycle.
steps.title: Choose Wash Cycle

steps.instruction: Put clothes from the basket into the washer drum.
steps.title: Load Clothes Inside

steps.instruction: Push the round washer door closed tight.
steps.title: Close Washer Door

guide.title: Wash Clothes in Washer
